title: History 17: Studios and agents: when models became pipelines

questions.q: When is a pipeline in one graph the natural choice?
options: When all steps fit in memory and need no stop between them
When a person must choose between steps
When steps run on different machines
When you want to resume next week
questions.answer: When all steps fit in memory and need no stop between them
questions.why: One graph shares the engine's cache. The other cases need several graphs.
